key_grammar.source_sentence: They do so by participating in scientific activities such as monitoring plants and wildlife, collecting air and water samples, categorizing galaxies, and analyzing DNA sequences.

explanation.text: 전치사 by, such as, in 뒤에는 동사가 그대로 오지 못하고 동명사(-ing)로 바뀌어 목적어가 됩니다.
예시를 들 때도 such as 뒤 동명사들이 병렬로 이어집니다(monitoring, collecting, categorizing, analyzing).
and로 연결되는 예시들은 모두 -ing 형태로 형태를 맞춰야 해요.
전치사 뒤에 to부정사나 동사원형을 쓰면 틀립니다(by to participate ✗).

key_grammar.example_analysis: 전치사 by와 such as 뒤에 동명사(participating, monitoring, collecting, categorizing, analyzing)가 목적어·병렬 예시로 온다.

drills.question: 다음 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 적절하지 않은 것은?
drills.sentence: They do so by [[1|participating]] in scientific activities such as [[2|monitoring]] plants and wildlife, [[3|collect]] air and water samples, [[4|categorizing]] galaxies, and [[5|analyzing]] DNA sequences.
drills.fix: such as 뒤 예시들은 동명사로 병렬을 이뤄야 하므로 collect → collecting(원문)으로 고쳐야 한다.

drills.question: 각 네모 안에서 어법에 맞는 것을 고르시오.
drills.sentence: Websites, smartphone apps, and social media [[have/has]] been instrumental in [[expanding/expand]] the reach and impact of a diversity of citizen science projects across time and geographical zones.

drills.question: 다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장은?
drills.answer: Examples include to set up and managing a website that offers local services for community disasters and creating an emergency response team when a disaster occurs.
drills.fix: include는 동명사를 목적어로 취하므로 to set up → setting up(원문)으로 고쳐야 한다.
options: ① The growth and success of citizen science and citizen engagement has been made possible by the Internet and mobile technology, encouraging and coordinating the efforts of millions of people throughout the world.
② Citizen science involves local people helping scientists carry out a scientific project at scale.

③ Currently, thousands of such projects have been set up all over the world, whereby volunteers help out in a number of research areas, including biodiversity, air quality, astronomy, and environmental issues.
④ Citizen engagement involves people helping governments, rather than scientists, to improve public services and policies in their communities.
⑤ Examples include to set up and managing a website that offers local services for community disasters and creating an emergency response team when a disaster occurs.

drills.question: 우리는 폐기물을 재활용하고 나무를 심는 것과 같은 활동에 참여함으로써 환경을 돕는다.
drills.answer: We help the environment by participating in activities such as recycling waste and planting trees.

drills.question: 그들은 식물과 야생동물을 관찰하고, 공기와 물 시료를 수집하고, 은하를 분류하고, DNA 서열을 분석하는 것과 같은 과학 활동에 참여함으로써 그렇게 한다.
drills.answer: They do so by participating in scientific activities such as monitoring plants and wildlife, collecting air and water samples, categorizing galaxies, and analyzing DNA sequences.

grammar.note: growth and success를 하나의 개념으로 봐 단수 has

has been made possible by the Internet and mobile technology,
encouraging and coordinating the efforts of millions of people throughout the world.

misreads.statement: 인터넷·모바일 기술이 시민 과학의 성장에 기여했지만, 그 성공은 주로 각국 정부의 예산 확대 때문이었다.
misreads.anchor: has been made possible by the Internet and mobile technology
